bead.title: Specify objectlog hybrid projection contract
bead.description: Update the governing specs before implementation. The plan has converged in docs/helix/04-build/hybrid-sqlite-inmemory-projection-plan.md. Make ADR-012, TD-001, TD-004, TP-003, and deployment/runtime docs normative for objectlog/hybrid: SQLite-first then memory apply, fail-closed poisoning if memory apply fails after SQLite commit, ProjectionImage hydration before returning SQLite high-water, object log as authority, no segment expiry based only on local SQLite, durable request-id replay for committed-but-unreturned pushes, generic ObjectLog group-commit runtime wiring, and concrete performance gates. In scope: docs/helix/02-design/**, docs/helix/03-test/**, docs/deployment/**, charts/pqueue/README.md if needed. Out of scope: Rust implementation changes beyond compile/doc link fixes.
